lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters are visible posterior to the gills. Centroids are arranged in vertical rows of 3 to 5 units, with roughly equidistant vertical spacing between blobs in the mid-flank area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Broad vertical bands of increased luminance intersect with the circular blobs. The blobs are centered within these vertical bands, forming a grid-like pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs. These are smaller and more irregularly spaced than the primary flank constellation nodes.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface displays a dense, high-frequency pattern of small white points, distinct from the larger blobs on the primary flank.
